journal.text:
I read through the minbpe lineage this session: lineage_bench.py lines 1-107, minbpe/__init__.py lines 1-12, and the core tokenizer files minbpe/base.py lines 1-378, minbpe/basic.py lines 1-239 and minbpe/regex.py lines 1-378. The goal was to understand how the benchmark exercises the tokenizers before touching anything.

Nothing was measured. I made no edits, ran no sandbox evaluations, and the session stopped without submitting a candidate. There are no results to quote.

What I now believe is limited to having seen the layout: base.py holds the shared machinery, basic.py and regex.py are the two tokenizer variants, and lineage_bench.py is what drives them. I have no evidence yet about where time or quality is lost, so any opinion on hot spots would be a guess.

Next session I should run lineage_bench.py unmodified first to get a baseline, then pick one concrete change in the merge or encode path of basic.py or regex.py, measure it in the sandbox, and only submit if the numbers support it.
